resources.string:
HearPrint plays soft beeps at eleven pitches, from 250 Hz to 12 kHz, and finds the quietest one you still hear at each. It then lifts the parts you hear less by about half the gap to typical hearing.
It never makes the sound darker: treble is never cut, and bass never gets more lift than treble.
Both ears hear the same curve, so the stereo image stays put. It\'s saved for this output only, and it measures your ears and headphones together. If AutoEQ is on, it leaves the headphone part to AutoEQ.
**Taste profile:** a few questions, then A/B choices on your own music. The voice stays the same level in both, so you\'re choosing tone, not volume.
It\'s a sound setting, not a hearing test, and it can\'t tell you anything medical.
Tune JadOO to your ears in about 90 seconds
Your HearPrint is saved but off
The curve for these headphones is removed. You can take the test again any time.
Nothing is saved, and your sound goes back to normal.
Everyone hears differently, and every pair of headphones sounds different. In about 90 seconds, JadOO learns how you hear each part of the sound and tunes itself to you.
Wear your headphones the right way round
Your music pauses during the test
Connect headphones to start. HearPrint is made for headphones.
You should hear beeps now. Use the volume buttons until they are soft but clear, like a quiet conversation. Keep this volume for the whole test.
Hold the button while you hear beeps. Let go as soon as they fade away. They come back; that is normal.
This is how JadOO will tune your sound, the same for both ears. Up means a part you hear less gets lifted.
Many tones were still heard at the quietest level. Your volume was probably high: turn it down a few steps and retake for a sharper result.
Some tones weren’t heard even at the loudest level. JadOO lifts them only up to its safe limit.
Your two checks at the same pitch differed. A quieter room or a retake may give a steadier result.
Your HearPrint curve, the same for both ears: up to %1$s dB lift
Some tones didn’t get a steady answer, so nothing was saved. Try again somewhere quieter and let go as soon as the beeps fade.
You pressed a few times while nothing was playing. That can blur the result; a quieter room helps.
The sound moved to another output, so this run stopped. Nothing was saved. Start again on the output you want to tune.
